hypothesis: H85-1 GEO-Pb: a fault is a JUXTAPOSITION, not a gradient. At each pixel and 8 candidate strikes, the offset difference of a covariance-whitened 10-band multi-physics stack across the candidate line (windowed Hotelling-style two-sample step), reduced by the MEDIAN of three independent physics domains so two of three must agree, times an along-strike persistence term over 1.5 km, then crest-thinned by non-maximum suppression across its own normal.
mechanism: A fault concealed under Holocene alluvium has no scarp but still juxtaposes different basement susceptibility, cover thickness and surface geochemistry. Each band changes a little; the joint 10-vector changes a lot. A derivative operator weights the magnitude of each band's change; a whitened two-sample statistic weights how improbable the JOINT change is.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Erosional volcanic mesa and lava-flow margins: straight, long, and expressed in all three physics domains (magnetic contrast, radiometric contrast, topographic step) with no tectonic offset. Declared as the irreducible confounder; the straightness term and the two-of-three vote do NOT remove it. Secondary, partly mitigated: distal alluvial-fan margins and Lake Lahontan shorelines (lobate -- suppressed by the 1.5 km straightness term) and aeromagnetic/radiometric acquisition seams (single-domain -- suppressed by the two-of-three median; azimuth audit in evidence/experiments.json shows max single-orientation share 0.254 < 0.35).
